source.description: Carries each package's source hash to its dependents, so a check reruns when a package it loads changes, without waiting for that package's checks.

typecheck.description: The incremental typecheck, `pnpm types`: each package's build info (node_modules/.cache/typecheck.tsbuildinfo, gitignored) lets a re-check check only what changed. The build info is no output: a hit replays the diagnostics, and a miss reads whatever build info the directory holds, which tsrs proves against the files' hashes. `pnpm check` runs this same task from scratch, with --incremental false passed through, which turbo hashes, so it never replays an incremental pass. The dev tools' tsconfig bases, which the root tsconfig and every package extend, are inputs too.

oxlint.description: The dev tools' preset and plugin and the repository's config are inputs too.

test.description: Every package's properties, through toolchain-test run. Each run draws a fresh rotating seed, so a run never replays from cache; the run's seed comes through the environment (and the old fuzz script's variables), and so does the PostgreSQL cluster the testing library's database properties need (libpq's PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGSSLMODE; CONTRIBUTING.md, "Properties that need a database").

//#workspace-gate.description: The repository-wide checks: every tsconfig and package manifest, and every file name git shows. It reads the whole tree and opens no TypeScript program, so it costs about a second, and a cache would have to hash the whole tree to know it could skip it.

//#dedupe.description: The lockfile is already deduplicated: pnpm dedupe would change nothing.
